info.name: Extra Time API
info.description: Every Extra Time endpoint. Run the whole collection top to bottom (Collection Runner or `npx newman run postman/extra-time.postman_collection.json -e postman/extra-time.postman_environment.json`). Auth logs in and keeps the access token in {{access}}; the refresh token travels as an HttpOnly cookie. Create requests save ids to collection variables, and Cleanup deletes everything it created.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Signup, login, the refresh cookie, profile changes and logout. Login saves the access token to {{access}}; the refresh token is an HttpOnly cookie that Postman stores and sends to /api/auth/ by itself.

item.name: Sign up with a weak password (400)

exec: pm.test("Access token in body, refresh token not", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.access).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(body).to.not.have.property("refresh"); });

item.name: Log in with a wrong password (401)

exec: pm.test("Has profile and stats", () => { const me = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(me).to.have.property("profile"); pm.expect(me).to.have.property("stats"); });

request.description: Uses the refresh_token cookie set by Log in. The server rotates it: the old cookie value is now blacklisted.

item.name: Change username to a taken one (400)

request.description: Blacklists every refresh token of the user and returns a fresh access token plus a new refresh cookie.

item.name: Change password with a wrong old password (400)

request.description: The cookie was blacklisted and cleared by Log out.

item.name: Log in again with the new password

request.description: Seeded player, used for the 403 examples.
Staff account: only staff may write eras and topics.

item.name: Eras
item.description: Public read; create, update and delete need a staff token ({{admin_access}}).

item.name: Topics
item.description: Public read; create, update and delete need a staff token.

item.name: Questions
item.description: Public read without answers; any logged-in user can write a question (choices are nested); only its author or staff can change it.

exec: pm.test("No is_correct for anonymous users", () => pm.response.json().results.forEach((q) => q.choices.forEach((c) => pm.expect(c).to.not.have.property("is_correct"))));

item.name: Get question as its author (with answers)
Choices
item.description: Standalone CRUD for choices. Only the parent question's author or staff can write; every write keeps 2-4 choices with exactly one correct.

item.name: Quiz & Attempts
item.description: Play a quiz as the Postman player: get questions, submit answers, read the saved attempt.

exec: pm.test("Five questions without answers", () => { pm.expect(quiz).to.have.length(5); quiz.forEach((q) => q.choices.forEach((c) => pm.expect(c).to.not.have.property("is_correct"))); });
pm.test("None of them are mine", () => quiz.forEach((q) => pm.expect(q.author).to.not.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("username"))));
pm.collectionVariables.set("quiz_answers", JSON.stringify(quiz.map((q, index) => ({ question: q.id, choice: index === 4 ? null : q.choices[0].id }))));

pm.test("Scored on the server", () => { const a = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(a.total).to.eql(5); pm.expect(a.answers[0]).to.have.property("correct_text"); pm.expect(a.answers[0]).to.have.property("explanation"); });

request.description: Attempts are a record of what happened and cannot be edited.

exec: pm.test("Ranked rows", () => { const rows = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(rows[0].rank).to.eql(1); pm.expect(rows[0]).to.have.property("total_correct"); });

item.name: Errors
item.description: Examples of the protections: 401 without a token, 403 for someone else's data, 400 for invalid input.

item.name: Cleanup
item.description: Deletes everything the collection created, the Postman account last, so the collection can run again.
